case.question: I fish from the pier for salmon. For this week, how good do you expect pier fishing for salmon to be at each of St. Joseph, South Haven, Grand Haven and Muskegon? Rate each port 0-4 (0 slow, 1 below average, 2 average, 3 good, 4 excellent) and say which you'd go to.

events.text:
## Recommendation

- **Go to St. Joseph's pier first.** Expect a 2 out of 4 (average).
- **Grand Haven and Muskegon:** expect 2 (average) at both, as backups.
- **South Haven:** expect 1 (below average). Check for closures first.
- **Pier rigs:** start with meat rigs and spoons, and try green flies. Fish early and late in low light, when the reports say the bite was best.
- **Depth:** I'd start lines around 50-80 ft down, the depth range boat anglers reported. Going deeper in 80-100 ft of water is also reasonable.

## Why

- **No recent pier salmon reports exist.** Every salmon report from the last six weeks came from boats, so these ratings are my estimates, not pier results.
- **St. Joseph has the best boat result nearby.** The Aug 10 St. Joseph boat report rated salmon good (3) in 80-100 ft of water, with deeper anglers catching more salmon.
- **South Haven's pier was closed.** The Aug 10 South Haven report said the piers were closed to fishing for several days because of red flag conditions, and its boat anglers caught a mixed bag.
- **Upwelling favors the piers.** I'd expect the hours of north-to-east wind at South Haven (35 h), St. Joseph (27 h), Grand Haven (25 h) and Muskegon (24 h) in the last three days to pull cold water toward the piers, which is why I rate St. Joseph highest.

## Evidence

**Recent reports (latest is Aug 10, six days old)**
- St. Joseph, boat, Aug 10: "Boat anglers targeting salmon had a good week… Anglers fishing 80 to 100 feet of water were catching lake trout and a few salmon. The deeper anglers caught more salmon." Rated 3 (good). Spin Doctors, flies and meat rigs worked best.
- Grand Haven, boat, Aug 10: fish 55-140 ft down in 130-220 ft of water. "Green flies and meat rigs worked well along with glow spoons." Rated 3 (good).
- Muskegon, boat, Aug 10: fish 55-130 ft down in 120-240 ft of water. "The best salmon bite occurred in low light conditions." Rated 3 (good).
- South Haven, Aug 10: piers closed to fishing for several days because of red flag conditions. Boat salmon results were not rated, and spoons worked best.
- Earlier, the Aug 3 reports were mostly good or average (Muskegon 3, St. Joseph 3, Grand Haven 2, South Haven 1). The July 14 reports from Grand Haven and Muskegon were slow (0).

**Past seasons (similar water temperature, about 68 F)**
- Similar weeks from earlier seasons matched only on the boat reports above (Aug 3 and July 20). No pier-specific salmon reports matched. So this is a weak guide.

**Conditions now (the tool returned a backtest summary for the week before Aug 16, not live data)**
- Satellite water at the piers (GLSEA, cell about 1-2.5 km off the pierhead, a satellite estimate) was about 72-74 F and fell 3-5 F in the last three days at all four ports. St. Joseph's pier water was 74 F, down 4 F in three days.
- Buoy surface readings for the same week dropped sharply at all four ports (63-70 F average), which suggests upwelling.
- No pierhead modeled water or wind forecast for the coming days was in the output.

## Caveats

- The newest report is six days old, and no pier-specific salmon report is in the data. Treat all pier ratings as estimates.
- The conditions I could retrieve were a backtest summary for the week before Aug 16. Live buoy readings and the pierhead model were unavailable, so I couldn't confirm the current water temperature or the wind forecast.
- Satellite pier-water values can lag 1-2 days behind real changes. The buoys are offshore, so they are better for timing but not for pier water.
- Check for pier closures before you go, especially at South Haven, where the red flag closed the piers last week.

## Sources

- St. Joseph, South Haven, Grand Haven, Muskegon, Aug 10 report: https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/327890a
- Aug 3 report: https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/3268d0b
- July 20 report (St. Joseph): https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/323f6bf
- July 14 report: https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/321350c
- July 6 report: https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/31f444a
